html: During a colonoscopy, a specialist guides a slim, bendable scope with a light and camera through the large intestine. It's the main way to find polyps and remove them before they can turn into cancer.

• Routine colorectal cancer screening, which many adults start at 45
  • Checking on bleeding, belly pain or a change in bowel habits
  • A follow-up after polyps were found before
The day before, you'll stick to clear liquids and drink a prep that empties the bowel. Most people get sedation, so plan for someone to drive you home.
Feeling bloated for a few hours is normal. Call your care team for heavy bleeding, fever or belly pain that gets worse.

title: Colonoscopy
abstract: Why colonoscopy is done, how to prepare and what to expect afterward.
